notes.title: Version 0.32
notes.notes:
Added bloom slider to settings

Added touch screen support

Fixed large number overflow bug

notes.title: Version 0.31
notes.notes:
CAMPAIGNS
This patch is about upping the difficulty. Last patch, the early levels were too easy, so it wasn't necessary to try to pick a good build or aim well. For that reason, the chill difficulty without a timer has been removed.
New difficulty levels
Lite

Hardcore

Maximum
MISS LIMIT
Added a miss counter that has a default limit of 10. Miss too many times and you'll get a game over.
OBJECTIVES
Completion of level objectives now reduce the price of random upgrades.
METAPROGRESSION
There is a now a meta upgrade to increase the campaign time limit.

Meta upgrades base price is now $0 instead of $10
UPGRADES
Removed ball limit upgrade.

Added a ball limit prestige mechanic that increases the ball limit by 10 each time you reset.

Added a miss limit upgrade that increases the miss limit and resets the current misses.

notes.title: Version 0.3
notes.notes:
ADDED: CAMPAIGN SYSTEM

Last patch you had four minutes to complete each level. That's a reasonable time limit if you already know how to play, but if you're playing for the first time that's not long enough for you to figure out what's going on. Now there are three difficulty levels, and the first difficulty level is untimed, so you have a chance to figure out how to play.

On the timed difficulty levels, instead of each level having a short timer, all levels share one longer timer.



CHANGED: PRESTIGE MECHANIC

Now you can choose to stay at the final objective tier to try to get to the earnings target or you can choose to prestige and reset the objectives.

When you prestige, you keep your upgrades, and the prices stay the same.

You want to prestige if you aren't making enough money or the upgrades are cheap. You want to stay on the final tier if you're close to hitting the earnings target or you think you can beat all the objectives easily.
